messages.subject: jShiny-server
parts:
Hi,

 

I am pleased to release jShiny-server, alternative to official Shiny-server.

 

It's similar to the official open-source Shiny-server.

It's powered by JVM and available for Windows/Linux/Mac.

Serve the static files to improve page load speed.

 

You can find more details: http://shiny.statsplot.com

 

This is the initial release, any feedback is welcome.

 

Regards,

Fan
